title: File:Chicory Root (40x).jpg
desc: Cross section of Cichorium intybus (chicory) root observed under a compound microscope. The image shows the central vascular cylinder surrounded by storage parenchyma tissue. The reddish coloration shows us the xylem region, which forms a star pattern in the center.
